_comment: What's to Come. These pieces are not in the Printify catalog and are not in production. title, expectedShip, and priceCents stay empty until the Founder sets them. Set enabled to true only after all three are filled in. priceCents is an integer count of cents. expectedShip is the exact customer-facing ship message. Do not guess either field. The optional bear pin is part of the cap description, not a second price.
